python -c 'exec("import duckdb, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path
out=Path("out"); out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
p="data/crashes.parquet"
q=f"""WITH by_day AS (SELECT crash_date, count(*) AS n FROM read_parquet(\047{p}\047) WHERE crash_date >= DATE \0472013-01-01\047 AND crash_date < DATE \0472026-01-01\047 GROUP BY crash_date), calendar AS (SELECT d::DATE AS day, coalesce(n, 0) AS n FROM generate_series(DATE \0472013-01-01\047, DATE \0472025-12-31\047, INTERVAL 1 DAY) g(d) LEFT JOIN by_day ON by_day.crash_date = g.d), agg AS (SELECT dayofweek(day) AS wd, strftime(day, \047%A\047) AS weekday, count(*) AS calendar_days, sum(n) AS crashes, avg(n) AS avg_per_day FROM calendar GROUP BY wd, weekday) SELECT weekday, calendar_days, crashes, 100.0 * crashes / sum(crashes) OVER () AS share_pct, avg_per_day FROM agg ORDER BY wd"""
df=duckdb.sql(q).df()
df["calendar_days"]=df["calendar_days"].astype(int); df["crashes"]=df["crashes"].astype(int)
# Option 1: the full-period distribution by share of all reported crashes.
one=df[["weekday","crashes","share_pct"]].copy(); one["share_pct"]=one["share_pct"].round(4); one.to_csv(out/"values_1.csv",index=False)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,5.6)); bars=ax.bar(one.weekday,one.crashes,color="#3478a8")
ax.set_title("NYC crashes by day of week, 2013–2025"); ax.set_ylabel("Police-reported crashes"); ax.set_xlabel("Day of week"); ax.grid(axis="y",alpha=.25); ax.set_axisbelow(True)
ax.set_ylim(0,one.crashes.max()*1.14)
for bar, row in zip(bars,one.itertuples()): ax.text(bar.get_x()+bar.get_width()/2,bar.get_height()+one.crashes.max()*.018,f"{row.crashes:,}\n{row.share_pct:.1f}%",ha="center",va="bottom",fontsize=9)
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(out/"option_1.png",dpi=160); plt.close(fig)
# Option 2: average counts per occurrence of each weekday, treating all calendar dates in range equally.
two=df[["weekday","crashes","calendar_days","avg_per_day"]].copy(); two["avg_per_day"]=two["avg_per_day"].round(4); two.to_csv(out/"values_2.csv",index=False)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,5.6)); bars=ax.bar(two.weekday,two.avg_per_day,color="#d47b35")
ax.set_title("Average NYC crashes per calendar day by weekday, 2013–2025"); ax.set_ylabel("Average police-reported crashes per day"); ax.set_xlabel("Day of week"); ax.grid(axis="y",alpha=.25); ax.set_axisbelow(True); ax.set_ylim(0,two.avg_per_day.max()*1.15)
for bar,row in zip(bars,two.itertuples()): ax.text(bar.get_x()+bar.get_width()/2,bar.get_height()+two.avg_per_day.max()*.018,f"{row.avg_per_day:.1f}",ha="center",va="bottom",fontsize=9)
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(out/"option_2.png",dpi=160); plt.close(fig)
print(df.to_string(index=False)); print("Total crashes:",int(df.crashes.sum()),"calendar days:",int(df.calendar_days.sum()))")'
